## Projects Done

### 1. CAT 1 - Kenya Maize Production Analysis (2022)

Tools: R, ggplot2, Tidyverse

- Compared Rift Valley vs Non-Rift production using t-test
- Modelled yield vs rainfall: R² = 60.3%
- Multiple regression: area drives total bags, rainfall + fertilizer drives yield
- Visualization: Top 15 maize producing counties bar chart
